test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The bus broke down because we had to walk some distance.
solution:
The correct answer is **'because we'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When we read the sentence, we get to know that **something happened because of that someone has to suffer.**
 
• All in all, **when the reason is given first and then the result or action, we must use 'that is why', 'therefore', or 'then after'.**
 
• **For example,**
 
 
• He had an accident **that is why **__people took him to the hospital.
 
• I forgot my purse, __**therefore **__I had to come back.
 
 
 
• So, when we observe the above sentences, we get to know that **there should be "that's why" instead of "because".**

**So the correct sentence is- ***The bus broke down** that is why** we had to walk some distance.*

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**Let's **understand the concept with some more examples.**

If the **action or result is given first and then the reason, we must use 'because'.**

 
• *I went to the market **because **I had to buy vegetables.*
 
• *She slept early **because **she wanted to wake up early.*
